## Load Packages
``` {r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(NPSpecies)
library(tigris)
```

``` {r read_data}
# load nps species data
nps_species_data <- NPSpecies::species %>%
  rename(unit_code = ParkCode) %>% 
  rename_with(str_to_lower)

# park boundary data
park_bounds <- st_read("data/admin_bounds.gdb/") %>% 
  st_transform("+proj=longlat +ellps=WGS84 +datum=WGS84") %>%
  # cast to multipolygon so st_make_valid will work
  mutate(shape = st_cast(shape, to = "MULTIPOLYGON")) %>%
  # make valid to fix overlapping edges
  mutate(shape = st_make_valid(shape)) %>% 
  mutate(centroid = st_centroid(shape, of_largest_polygon = T),
         lon = st_coordinates(centroid)[, 1],
         lat = st_coordinates(centroid)[, 2])
# subset to geo data without sf geometries
geo_small <- park_bounds %>%
  select(unit_code, state, region, unit_type, shape_Area, lat, lon)
```

``` {r practice mapping}
saguaro <- park_bounds %>% 
  filter(unit_code == "SAGU")
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = park_bounds %>% filter(unit_code == "SAGU"))
# plot centroids of all parks
states <- tigris::states()
park_bounds_point_only <- park_bounds %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(-centroid) %>% 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = states) +
  geom_sf(data = park_bounds_point_only)
```
